## Meeting Info

- Date & Time: February 5th, 2025, 15:00 UTC
- Duration: 60 minutes
- Zoom: [Link](https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88940506383?pwd=aTdsbHVyMTNDSUFHYmhTWlI2ZEVldz09)

📅 Subscribe to the [Ethereum Protocol Call calendar](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/1?cid=Y191cGFvZm9uZzhtZ3JtcmtlZ243aWM3aGs1c0Bncm91cC5jYWxlbmRhci5nb29nbGUuY29t) for calendar invites

### Resources

<details>

- [Current specs](https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/blob/main/spec/eof.md)
    - [EIP-7692: EVM Object Format (EOFv1) Meta](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7692)
    - [EOFCREATE hashing + Cross chain addresses potential features and scenarios](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/SyrzctZSJg)
    - EIPs Included <details>
[EIP-3540](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3540): EOF - EVM Object Format v1
[EIP-3670](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3670): EOF - Code Validation

[EIP-4750](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4750): EOF - Functions
[EIP-5450](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-5450): EOF - Stack Validation
[EIP-6206](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-6206): EOF - JUMPF and non-returning functions
[EIP-7480](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7480): EOF - Data section access instructions
[EIP-663](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-663): SWAPN, DUPN and EXCHANGE instructions
[EIP-7069](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7069): Revamped CALL instructions
[EIP-7620](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7620): EOF Contract Creation
[EIP-7698](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7698): EOF - Creation transaction </details>
- [EOF Meeting Playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJqWcTqh_zKHu7Z91YVYWy_PSmOc_66-F) 
- EVM (EOF) [Taxonomy](https://rakita.github.io/blog/EVM%20(EOF)%20Taxonomy.png)
- EOF explainers on [PEEPanEIP](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4cwHXAawZxqOHV_F40AJbzcl8b6tG8xw) <details>
[EVM Object Format (EOF) with Danno Ferrin](https://youtu.be/rlZwPuF149U)
[EVM Object Format (EIP-3540 & EIP-3670) with Andrei Maiboroda, Axic & Pawel](https://youtu.be/GMeRA-xPp-E) </details>
- [EOF Testing Coverage Tracker](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/main/tests/osaka/eip7692_eof_v1/eof_tracker.md)
  - [Implementation Matrix](https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/blob/main/spec/implementation_matrix.md)
- [Solidity + EOF POC summary](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/solidity_eof_poc)
- Matrix on [evmobjectformat.org](https://evmobjectformat.org/)

</details>

- Prev [meeting notes](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eof-implementers-call-65-january-22-2025/22466/2)

## Agenda

- Testing Updates
  - General EEST updaes (mario)
  - Converting legacy tests to EEST (@chfast)
- Client and Compiler Update
- Non-specification Issues:
  - Proposed testnet plan: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/eof-testnets-plan
- Specification Issues
- Osaka-1 cleanup items
  - https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/176
  - Remaining [List of items](https://notes.ethereum.org/oi698hfNTSG_oe9xHIgSaA?both#Osaka-1-%E2%80%9CCleanup%E2%80%9D)
    - Modify type section to have "additional stack" instead of total stack
    - Change EOFCREATE stack order to match EXTCALL
    - Any other stack arg re-ordering to align with legacy or other EOF ops
    - Rename RETURNCONTRACT to RETURNCODE
    - Change data section index from 0x04 to 0xff
      - Retire the 0x04 header ID.
    - Change CREATE/CREATE2 to an exceptional halt when seeing EOF (was fails and returns 0)
  - TXCREATE [EIP-7873](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9299/files?short_path=f9e4aac#diff-f9e4aac074d7b4ec62e32d78d6107364f7e3470ba61809a24b26675b45bfe7f4)
    - Q: Do we need to block DELEGATECALL?
      - Will impact generated address namespace
    - Q: Is address hashing OK with everyone?
    - Q: Is toehold contract OK wih everyone?
    - Q: What other toehold variants for the ERC?
    - Add Metadata Section [EIP-7834](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7834)
    - Add EXTCODETYPE [EIP-7761](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7761)
    - Add CODEADDRESS opcode



Please add other agenda items or links to discuss.

### Next call on February 19th, 2025
